description.fun: Piplup is far too proud to accept food from people, and it's hard to bond with because it won't listen to its Trainer. It walks badly and falls over a lot, then puffs out its chest as if nothing happened, yet in the water it can dive for over ten minutes to hunt. Its English name was nearly 'Piploop', dropped for sounding a bit too much like 'poop'.
description.guide: Piplup is a Water-type penguin and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is very proud, refuses food from people and is hard to bond with, but it swims well and can dive for over ten minutes. It evolves into Prinplup and then Empoleon.
description.tagline: A proud little penguin who'd rather fall than accept help.

description.fun: Every Prinplup believes it is the most important Pokémon around, so they can never form a group and each lives alone. Its stubby wings are no joke: one blow can snap the thickest of trees. It swims gracefully through frigid seas and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. Its name joins 'prince' with 'plup', the sound of a pebble dropping into water.
description.guide: Prinplup is the evolved form of Piplup, a Water-type penguin. Each one considers itself the most important, so it lives alone, hunting in icy seas, and its wings are strong enough to snap trees. It evolves into Empoleon.
description.tagline: A princely penguin too self-important to join a group.

description.fun: Empoleon is an emperor in every sense: the three horns of its trident-shaped beak show its strength, and a colony's leader has the biggest. Its wings slice through ice floes, it swims as fast as a jet boat, and its name nods to Napoleon. It's the only Steel-type evolved starter, and no other Pokémon shares its Water and Steel typing.
description.guide: Empoleon is the final form of Piplup, a Water- and Steel-type emperor penguin. The horns on its beak signal its strength, the largest belonging to a colony's leader, and its wing edges can cut through drifting ice. People in ancient Hisui called it the Master of the Waves.
description.tagline: An emperor penguin with a trident for a beak.
